observations: Photo 0: A dark-blue and white desktop laser printer on a wooden table, small control panel with screen on right side, output tray on top, paper tray at bottom marked, power cable visible at rear.

Photo 1: Close-up front view showing brand text 'KYOCERA' and model text 'ECOSYS P3045dn' with 'Ecosys' logo on the front panel; small screen appears lit with an orange/red indicator; 'A4' label visible on lower tray; minor smudges/marks on white panel; power button visible on right side.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'IFEOLUWA' overlay both images, consistent with a listing photo, not indicative of item condition.
No visible printed test page, toner gauge, page counter, or network/USB port in either photo.

claims.claim: Kyocera ECOSYS P3045dn A4 Mono Laser Printer
claims.evidence: Brand and model text visible on front panel in photo 1
Marketing description; no performance metric or test print shown in either photo

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and producing a printed test page
Photo of the control panel status/menu showing toner level and page count
Close-up photo of rear ports (USB, Ethernet) and any visible model/serial label
Photo of all included accessories (cables, manuals, toner)
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly legible in photo 1, allowing identification, but no functional proof (power-on, print test, toner level) is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly non-working unit.
